name: John Monash
contribution: An Australian military commander of the First World War and a civil engineer.

checks.lead: General Sir John Monash (; 27 June 1865 – 8 October 1931) was an Australian military commander of the First World War and a civil engineer. He commanded the 13th Infantry Brigade before the war and then, shortly after its outbreak, became commander of the 4th Brigade in Egypt, with which he took part in the Gallipoli campaign.
